```{r}
# read in csv files from tcrit runs 1-10

run1 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260804_run1_kinetics_results.csv")
run2 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260804_run2_kinetics_results.csv")
run3 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260805_run3_kinetics_results.csv")
run4 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260805_run4_kinetics_results.csv")
run5 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260807_run5_kinetics_results.csv")
run6 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260807_run6_kinetics_results.csv")
run7 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260810_run7_kinetics_results.csv")
run8 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260810_run8_kinetics_results.csv")
run9 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260811_run9_kinetics_results.csv")
run10 <- read.csv("Tcrit/data_processed/20260814_run10_kinetics_results.csv")

# merge all tcrit runs 

run_list <- list(run1, run2, run3, run4, run5, run6, run7, run8, run9, run10)

tcrit_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(run_list), function(i) {
  df <- run_list[[i]]
  df$run <- paste0("run", i)
  df
}))

tcrit_df <- tcrit_df[!grepl("^NA\\d*$", tcrit_df$LeafID), ]

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

tcrit_df <- tcrit_df %>%
  mutate(species = str_remove(LeafID, "_\\d+$"))

tcrit_species_avg <- tcrit_df %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_tcrit = mean(Tcrit, na.rm = TRUE), n = n())

tcrit_species_avg <- tcrit_df %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), n = n())

(unique(tcrit_df$species))

species_fixes <- c(
  "Notholithocarpus_densiflorus" = "Lithocarpus_densiflorus",
  "Quercus_wizleni"               = "Quercus_wislizeni",
  "Pinus_jefferyi"                = "Pinus_jeffreyi",
  "Sequoiadendron_gigantium"      = "Sequoiadendron_giganteum",
  "Pinus_couteri"                 = "Pinus_coulteri",
  "Betula_papyifera"              = "Betula_papyrifera",
  "Platanus_racesmosa"            = "Platanus_racemosa",
  "Abies_amabiis"                 = "Abies_amabilis",
  "Aesculus_californicus"         = "Aesculus_californica",
  "Quercus_engelmanii"            = "Quercus_engelmannii"
)

tcrit_df$species <- ifelse(tcrit_df$species %in% names(species_fixes),
                            species_fixes[tcrit_df$species],
                            tcrit_df$species)

ggplot(tcrit_df %>% filter(run != "run7"), aes(x = reorder(species, Tcrit, median), y = Tcrit)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Tcrit (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

```
